CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (node red coordinates), its presentation (coordinate assignment) and a separate origin/status are explicitly recorded for the same node/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to an identified content's presentation or access is stated.

C.rationale: Report explicitly names node identifiers with associated color-valued coordinate sets (content and attribute).

D.rationale: The report separately attributes an origin/status object to the identified node content, distinguishing identity from status.

O.rationale: The coordinate assignments to named nodes indicate how the content is represented/presented in the model record.
